title: Pricing function contradicts the base's bill-of-materials attribution
description: SA defect, Raise to SO: the base attributes BOM emission to the composition function in three places, but composition's signature takes no token counts. The 1b decomposition is correct; the base wording must update to name the pricing function, and the pricing function needs a purity criterion binding it. [owner: solution-architect; validator: solution-owner]

comments.author: xqjG
